dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit a high-contrast transition from the dark dorsal base to light-grey perimeters. The perimeters are characterized by jagged, non-uniform edges with a sharp gradient from the dark exterior into the high-intensity ring pixels.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, discrete light-toned pixel clusters located primarily on the anterior neck region and lower lateral flanks, appearing as solid points without internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent macro-annuli on the upper mid-back form an asymmetrical trapezoid with its primary axis aligned longitudinally with the spine.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A group of three small, dark, circular punctate marks is visible on the lower lateral flank, approximately mid-way between the pectoral and hind flippers.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, high-contrast horizontal white band is visible across the dorsal neck area, localized within a skin fold.
